### Load lib

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

## Download all data

```{r}
dir.create(path = here("data"))
dir.create(path = here("data/_raw"))

```

```{r}
options(timeout = max(300, getOption("timeout")))


urls <- c("https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE141nnn/GSE141549/suppl/GSE141549%5FIllumina%5FHumanHT%2D12%5FV4%2E0%5Fexpression%5Fbeadchip%5Fnormalized%2Exlsx",
          
          "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE141nnn/GSE141549/suppl/GSE141549%5FIllumina%5FHumanWG%2D6%5Fv2%2E0%5Fexpression%5Fbeadchip%5Fnormalized%2Exlsx",
          
          "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE141nnn/GSE141549/suppl/GSE141549%5FNon%2Dnormalized%5Fdata%5FGA%5Fillumina%5Fexpression%5FHumanWG%2D6%2Exls%2Egz",
          
          "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE141nnn/GSE141549/suppl/GSE141549%5FNon%2Dnormalized%5Fdata%5FGA%5Fillumina%5Fexpression%5Fplatform%5FHumanHT%2D12%2Exls%2Egz",
          "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE141nnn/GSE141549/suppl/GSE141549%5FSample%5Flink%2Exlsx",
          "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE141nnn/GSE141549/suppl/GSE141549%5FbatchCorrectednormalizedArrayscombined%2Exlsx")

destfiles <- c("data/_raw/illum_HT.gz",
               "data/_raw/illum_WG.gz",
               "data/_raw/NN_WG.gz",
               "data/_raw/NN_HT.gz",
               "data/_raw/Sample_link.gz",
               "data/_raw/batchCN_array_combined.gz")

download.file(url = urls, 
              destfile = here(destfiles),
              method = "libcurl",
              mode = "wb")


```
